teams.detail: Eliminated by Cavaliers in East Semis (L G7, 94-125 on May 18). Best playoff run since 2008. Front office evaluating roster ahead of June draft.
Swept in KC: lost Sat 5-0, Sun 8-6. Five games below .500 at Memorial Day benchmark. Home series resumes Tuesday.
Open 2026 vs. Patriots Sept. 9 — Super Bowl LX rematch. 6 primetime games. Added Dante Fowler Jr. (DE). OTAs underway.
Home opener Sept 5. Schedule set: Apple Cup, Big Ten vs. Minnesota, home finale vs. Indiana (nat'l champs). Portal additions on defense.
2026 additions: Lattimore Ford (commit), Venters (Gonzaga), Watts (Texas Tech), Beasley (USF). 3 roster spots remain for 2026-27.

headlines.headline: THUNDER LEADS SPURS 2-1, GAME 4 TONIGHT; KNICKS UP 3-0 ON CAVALIERS, CLOSEOUT MONDAY
headlines.detail: OKC won Game 3 in San Antonio Friday. West Finals G4 tips tonight on ABC. East: NYK one win from first Finals since 1999; G4 Monday in Cleveland.

headlines.headline: MARINERS DROP BACK-TO-BACK IN KC, FALL TO 24-29 AT MEMORIAL DAY BENCHMARK
headlines.detail: Shut out 5-0 Saturday, lost 8-6 Sunday. Five games below .500. Home series resumes Tuesday after holiday.

headlines.headline: SEAHAWKS OPEN 2026 VS. PATRIOTS IN SUPER BOWL LX REMATCH; SIGNED DANTE FOWLER JR.
headlines.detail: Reigning SB LX champs (29-13 vs NE) open at home Sept. 9 in rematch. 6 primetime games on schedule. Added DE Dante Fowler Jr. this week.

headlines.headline: WASHINGTON 2026 SCHEDULE SET: HOME FINALE VS. REIGNING CHAMPION INDIANA
headlines.detail: Home opener Sept 5. Big Ten opener vs. Minnesota, Apple Cup on deck. Husky Stadium finale vs. Indiana (nat'l champs). ~103 days to kickoff.
